drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to help manage blood sugar levels.
precautions: Often taken with or after food to ease stomach upset.
Tell your doctor before any scan that uses contrast dye.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to help lower blood sugar levels.
precautions: Can cause low blood sugar, especially if meals are skipped.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to help manage blood pressure.
precautions: Can make you feel dizzy when standing up quickly.
Your doctor may check kidney tests and potassium from time to time.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to help manage blood pressure and some types of chest pain.
precautions: Ankle swelling can happen; mention it to your doctor if you notice it.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to help manage blood pressure and protect the heart and kidneys.
precautions: A dry cough can happen; tell your doctor if it bothers you.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to help lower cholesterol.
precautions: Tell your doctor about unexplained muscle pain or weakness.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to help lower cholesterol.
precautions: Tell your doctor about unexplained muscle pain or weakness.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to replace thyroid hormone when the thyroid makes too little.
precautions: Usually taken on an empty stomach, apart from calcium or iron tablets, as your doctor advises.

drugs.usedFor: At low doses it is generally used to help prevent blood clots.
precautions: Can irritate the stomach; tell your doctor about any unusual bleeding or black stools.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used for pain and fever.
precautions: Many cold and pain products also contain it — check labels so you don't take it twice.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used for pain, swelling and fever.
precautions: Usually taken with food.
Tell your doctor if you have kidney, stomach or heart problems.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to reduce stomach acid.
precautions: Often taken before breakfast, as your doctor advises.

drugs.usedFor: This combination is generally used for acidity and to help the stomach empty.
precautions: Usually taken before meals, as your doctor advises.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to reduce stomach acid.
precautions: Often taken before a meal, as your doctor advises.

drugs.usedFor: It is an antibiotic generally used for some bacterial infections.
precautions: Finish the course exactly as prescribed, even if you feel better.

drugs.usedFor: It is an antibiotic generally used for some bacterial infections.
precautions: Tell your doctor about any penicillin allergy.
Finish the course exactly as prescribed.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used for allergy symptoms like sneezing and itching.
precautions: Can make some people sleepy.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to support calcium and vitamin D levels.
precautions: Often taken apart from thyroid or iron tablets, as your doctor advises.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to raise low vitamin D levels.
precautions: Take exactly as prescribed — some forms are weekly, not daily.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to raise low iron levels.
precautions: Can darken stools and upset the stomach.
Often taken apart from tea, coffee or calcium.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to raise low vitamin B12 levels.
precautions: Take as prescribed.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to relieve wheezing and breathlessness.
precautions: Ask your doctor or pharmacist to check your inhaler technique.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to help prevent asthma and allergy symptoms.
precautions: Tell your doctor about any mood or sleep changes.

drugs.usedFor: It is generally used to prevent nausea and vomiting.
precautions: Can cause constipation or headache.
